_ordering_rationale: Avery Dennison = 2 segments depuis 2022: Materials Group (~69%, label/graphics) et Solutions Group (~31%, RFID/Intelligent Labels). KPIs ordres: Materials Sales (coeur historique), Solutions Sales (croissance RFID), Materials Adj OI, Solutions Adj OI, capex.

kpis.signal: Coeur historique: pressure-sensitive labels (Fasson, JAC, Mactac). Reprise FY24 apres destockage FY23
kpis.description_fr: CA Materials Group: materiaux adhesifs sensibles a la pression (labels, graphics, tapes). ~69% du CA total. Avantage compétitif: échelle mondiale + science des matériaux pour Intelligent Labels.
kpis.description_en: Materials Group revenue: pressure-sensitive label materials (labels, graphics, tapes). ~69% of total. Competitive edge: global scale + materials science backbone for Intelligent Labels.

kpis.signal: Coeur PV: Intelligent Labels RFID, croissance +68% sur 5 ans, deploiement Walmart/Decathlon/Inditex
kpis.description_fr: CA Solutions Group: Intelligent Labels RFID, apparel branding, identification solutions (Vestcom). Plateforme RFID en hypercroissance, change la these AVY de packaging vers tech.
kpis.description_en: Solutions Group revenue: RFID Intelligent Labels, apparel branding, ID solutions (Vestcom). Hypergrowth RFID platform shifts AVY thesis from packaging to tech.

kpis.signal: Marge ~15% Materials, leverage operationnel sur reprise volume. FY24 record
kpis.description_fr: Resultat operationnel ajuste segment Materials. Marge ~15%. Note: 2020-2021 sont Income Before Taxes (segment), 2022-2024 sont Segment Adj Op Income (presentation revue en 2024).
kpis.description_en: Materials Group adjusted segment operating income. ~15% margin. Note: 2020-2021 use Income Before Taxes (segment), 2022-2024 use Segment Adj Op Income (2024 presentation revised).

kpis.signal: Marge Solutions ~10.5%, mix RFID = leverage marge a long terme
kpis.description_fr: Resultat op. ajuste Solutions Group. Marge ~10-11%. Le mix vers Intelligent Labels (haute valeur) doit pousser la marge segmentaire vers 13-15%.
kpis.description_en: Solutions Group adj op income. ~10-11% margin. RFID/Intelligent Labels mix shift should push segment margin to 13-15%.

kpis.signal: Capex en baisse FY24 (efficacite), capacite RFID Bresil/Mexique installee
kpis.description_fr: Capex total. Cycle d'investissement RFID (nouvelles usines Bresil + Mexique consolide) maintenant en phase d'optimisation.
kpis.description_en: Total capex. RFID investment cycle (Brazil + Mexico consolidation) now in optimization phase.
